items.source: Enable Redis Pub/Sub listener annotated endpoints that are created under the cover by a RedisListenerAnnotationBeanPostProcessor.
items.translation: 启用由 RedisListenerAnnotationBeanPostProcessor 在后台创建的带有 Redis Pub/Sub 监听器注解的端点。

items.source: Annotation that marks a method to be the target of a Redis Pub/Sub message listener on the specified RedisListener.topic().
items.translation: 用于标记方法作为指定RedisListener.topic()的 Redis 发布/订阅消息监听目标的注解。

items.source: Bean post-processor that registers methods annotated with RedisListener to be subscribed to a Redis message listener container according to the attributes of the annotation.
items.translation: 注册带有RedisListener注解的方法，以便根据该注解的属性将其订阅到 Redis 消息监听器容器中。

items.source: Container annotation that aggregates several RedisListener annotations.
items.translation: 聚合多个RedisListener注解的容器注解。

items.source: Root package for integrating Redis with Spring concepts.
items.translation: 用于将 Redis 与 Spring 概念集成的根包。

items.source: Annotations and support classes for declarative Redis listener endpoints.
items.translation: 声明式 Redis 监听器端点的注解和支持类。
